author: Kiana Raymondo
title: Mountain lion spotted in Hanford captured and tranquilized - NewsBreak
text:
By Kiana Raymondo ,
5 hours ago
The "all-clear" has been given to residents in Hanford after authorities captured and tranquilized a large mountain lion late Wednesday afternoon.
Several people spotted the animal roaming through neighborhoods.
An ABC30 insider shared home security video of the lion.
You can see the big cat walking through their front yard early this morning on Merritt Street, between Centennial Drive and 12th Avenue.
Authorities had urged residents to stay indoors and keep a close eye on pets.
But by late Wednesday afternoon, the mountain lion was tranquilized and officials say there is no longer a threat to the community.
